title: Natural evaluation-adjoint comparison for diagonal adic completion
statement: For a prime ell and scheme W, take the existing integral simultaneous derived reduction D with DiagonalCompletionSpec, any normalized total derived limit L on constant ell-adic module towers, and any normalized simultaneous derived quotient N on constant ell-adic modules. For each n, let E_n be exact derived evaluation. There is a natural isomorphism beta: D.T followed by L.R, N.T and E_n to D.T followed by E_n. For every integral derived K, the composite of N.unit_n at L.R(D.T(K)) with beta(K) is exactly L.projection_n at D.T(K). This assertion involves no completed coefficient module, completed scalar restriction, supported or Tate endpoint, or lifted morphism.

source.place: paragraph (3), reduction of the limit map via the adjoint of each tower projection

proof.text: Identify D.T with the strict K-flat quotient model by the cokernel presentations and uniqueness of pointwise left derived functors. Identify the supplied total right derived limit L with the normalized adic completion model, retaining its projections. The finite quotient has the two-term free resolution, and the adic completion reduction theorem makes the adjoint of the actual limit projection an isomorphism.

Identify N with the derived quotient of that same constant coefficient module category using its universal counit. Its normalized units identify the comparison with the adjoint of projection, yielding the displayed unit equation. Naturality of the adic comparison on K-flat representatives and localization gives the full natural isomorphism beta on the integral derived category.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_adic_evaluation_comparison (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalMod ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalSystems ℓ W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction ℓ (diagonalScalarExtension ℓ W))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec ℓ W D)
    (L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod ℓ W))
    (N : DiagonalCompletedReductionData ℓ (DiagonalMod ℓ W)) (n : ℕ) :
    let E := ((evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (DiagonalMod ℓ W)).obj (op n)).mapDerivedCategory
    ∃ β : D.T ⋙ L.R ⋙ N.derived.T ⋙ E ≅ D.T ⋙ E,
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W),
        (N.unit n).app (L.R.obj (D.T.obj K)) ≫ β.hom.app K =
          (L.projection n).app (D.T.obj K)
